authority: Royal Borough of Windsor and Maidenhead

quirks.summary: File GETs require a Referer header set to the documents-tab URL.
quirks.detail: Without the Referer header every file GET 404s, returning an HTML 'Page not found' page in place of the file.
quirks.workaround: Send the documents-tab URL as Referer on every file GET, as Recipe C step 5 does.

source_notes: Idox. REQUIRES Referer=documents-tab URL on file GET — without it every file 404s (returns HTML 'Page not found').
